messages:
Sofia T.: dropped a prototype for latency view — p95 area + stacked heatmap + range scrub + sampling chip. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/latency-dashboard-proto :eyes:
Ravi M.: looks promising. quick flag: heatmap color ramp flattens at tails. can we try viridis or a cubehelix ramp and add numeric tick anchors?
Olga N.: p95 line weight feels light on the light theme. bump to 2.5px and try #003f9f or add a 1px halo so it reads against gridlines.
Ben C.: sampling default: 1/10 hides intermittent spikes. suggest default 1/5 for per-route dashboard, keep 1/10 for account-global view.
Sofia T.: good call. also thinking of a small badge next to time picker that shows sample rate. e.g., "Sampling: 1/5 (est tails)" — would that be too noisy?
Ravi M.: helpful. add a tooltip: "Sampling: 1 in 5 requests — tail estimates". put it right of the time picker so users see it when changing ranges.
Olga N.: layout: stacked above 1280px vs side-by-side? Side-by-side cramped <1200px. default to stacked for <=1280, and add a split/stack toggle for widescreens.
Ben C.: heatmap hover should give counts + median/p95 for that bucket. current hover only shows count which isn't enough for triage.
A11yBot: automated scan: `.p95-line` (#2f75ff on #ffffff) contrast ratio 3.6:1 — fails. suggestions: #003f9f or add 2px outline. Also ensure chart series have focusable elements and `aria-label="P95 latency for selected route"`.
Sofia T.: noted. action items: 1) try darker p95 + halo, 2) default sampling 1/5 in dashboard, 3) add sample-rate badge next to time picker, 4) swap heatmap palette + add ticks, 5) stacked-by-default <=1280 + toggle, 6) add aria attrs and keyboard tooltips. I'll push updated frames later today. :thumbsup:
Ravi M.: micro-copy: change the time picker label to "Time range & sampling" when sampling control is visible to improve discoverability.
Olga N.: keyboard: time scrubber needs role=slider and `aria-valuetext` like "Range: 1h to now". ensure focus ring meets high-contrast mode.
Ben C.: small UI nit: collapse vertical legend on narrow screens into a slim color bar with numeric anchors below the heatmap to save vertical space.
Sofia T.: thanks everyone — will iterate and post diffs.
